items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: And Zutty was on most all of them. >> [INTERVIEWER] The piano player Calvin Jackson? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Well, yeah, every time we recorded, there were different guys on the date. Willie Smith was on some of them and Ray Linn was on a lot of them and the piano player I was telling you about. And Zutty was on most all of them.
